output.subject: We have received your complaint about the payment made on 9/17
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for speaking with us. We know this has been a very distressing time, and we want you to know your complaint has been received and recorded.

You told us that on 9/17 you received a call that appeared on your caller ID as Meridian Harbor Bank. You mentioned that the caller told you to move your money to a "safe account," and that you sent $4,950 through Zelle as instructed. You told us you realized the next morning that something was wrong and filed a fraud claim. You also mentioned being told that claims for payments you authorized may not be eligible. You have asked us to review your claim and help you recover the $4,950.

A specialist team is now reviewing your complaint and will respond to you within 10 business days. In the meantime, if you receive any further calls or messages about this matter that concern you, please do not act on them, and contact us directly.

We're sorry for the worry and upset this has caused you.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer is 73, lives alone and was described as very distraught; consider vulnerable-customer handling and whether a phone follow-up is appropriate.
Confirm the fraud claim reference and status before sending; draft does not take a position on eligibility or recovery.
Decide whether to add specific guidance on how the bank contacts customers and how to verify calls; draft includes only a general caution.
Confirm the 'contact us directly' line is appropriate and add the correct verified contact route if desired.
Check whether the account should be reviewed for further exposure (e.g., other payments, credentials shared during the call).
Customer request: review of fraud claim and recovery of $4,950.
